Only a small percentage of total UPI volume will be affected by this new charge. RuPay debit card transactions will remain free, mitigating cash transaction concerns. The ministry will monitor to prevent MDR burden transfer to consumers. This measure aims to create a sustainable digital payments ecosystem framework.

sectors.title: Curefoods revenue grows 23% YoY, Rebel Foods' revenue up 20%
sectors.summary: The operating revenue of Curefoods, which recently paused its IPO plans, grew 23% YoY to Rs 916 crore in FY26, up from Rs 746 crore in FY25, according to its consolidated financial statements sourced from the Registrar of Companies (RoC).
